notes: Toy configuration for VS3 Task 7 planted fixture WIN-MARGIN-1 (.kiro spec ascension-trials-scalable-two-player-analysis): a state + opponent mixture where the WIN-utility best response differs from the MARGIN-utility best response (REQ-7.3).

One fungible normal domain; two Trials worth first=2 (t1) and first=3 (t2), second=0; optional allocation with residue; winner-take-all with shared-full ties; trial tiebreak total_power then shared; no final tiebreak, so Recognition-Point ties resolve as a shared final result (win utility 0).

Hand oracle (A budget 2, B budget 2, opponent mixture {B plays nothing, B plays (1 on t1, 1 on t2)} each prob 1/2): A=(1,1) sweeps both Trials vs the empty B (margin +5, win +1) but only ties the (1,1) B (margin 0, win 0), so E[margin]=5/2 and E[win]=1/2. A=(0,2) guarantees winning the richer t2 (worth 3) against BOTH opponents while conceding t1: vs empty B margin +3 win +1, vs (1,1) B margin +1 win +1, so E[margin]=2 and E[win]=1. Thus the margin oracle uniquely picks (1,1) (5/2 > 2) while the win oracle uniquely picks (0,2) (1 > 1/2): the two objectives are not interchangeable (REQ-5, REQ-7.3). Oracles are transcribed from the rules, not reverse-engineered from oracle output (REQ-9.4).
